storyCards.headline: Alejandro: The Breakthrough Moment
storyCards.fact:
Lady Gaga's "Alejandro" reached #5 on the Billboard Hot 100. "Alejandro" is a song by the American singer Lady Gaga from her third extended play (EP), The Fame Monster (2009)—the reissue of her album The Fame (2008).

The song peaked at #5 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 23 weeks on the chart.

Alejandro was released in 2009.
